description: Per-array SHA-256 of the WRF v4.6.1 RRTMG post-init coefficient state (raw RRTMG_*_DATA images plus every cmbgb reduction target), dumped by tools/rrtmg_wrf461_oracle/coeffs_dump_lw|sw after rrtmg_lwinit/rrtmg_swinit ran on the unmodified WRF sources. Hashes cover the native little-endian C-order byte image of each array.
